==Description==
'''Wretched Front''' is a [[Maps|map]] that seems to take place somewhere deep in the [[Old World|Nil Zone]].

This map is only in the map rotation for [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes.

==Design & Path==
'''Wretched Front''' is a battlefront located in the [[Old World|Nil Zone]]. It contains a small island surrounded by a purple liquid. On the other side of the moat, there are multiple cliffs. The island itself contains a few towers connected by chains, a few cliffs and various abandoned swords and banners. A few destroyed [[Siege Engine]]s also appear there.

The path starts at a large wall with eyes on the sides and a gate meant to be a mouth and ends at a small entrance accessed through a bridge. The path weaves around various obstacles on the map.

{{Map:Wretched Front}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Easy|Easy = Hide|Casual = Hide|Intermediate = Hide|Molten = Hide|Fallen = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*The many u-turns on this and the central part of the map are the ideal spots for towers due to their path coverage.
